title: RE60019: Failure Data Organization & Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Organization and management of reliability data. Data Banks and Data storage
and retrieval system. Statistical concepts probability distributions, methods
for single sample (Maximum likelihood estimation, goodness of fit, etc.),
regression models for data, proportional hazards modeling, Bayesian approach,
multivariate models, repairable systems, model for system reliability.
